headline: SME Association to government: 13+1 proposals for small businesses – 120 installments and a 20% tax
summary: The Greek SME Association calls on the government for a package of tax and financing measures for small businesses. Proposals include 120 installments and a 20% tax rate.
why: Tax and debt-repayment terms affect the cash flow and survival of small businesses, which make up most of Greece's private sector employment.
